_evidence: Per-car state tables read by 0x0043ced2 for car index c = (car byte +0x7c & 0x3f) - 1 = 0..21 (car_0043ced2): byte 0x7c2a74[c] (cmp 2; jne: 2 returns [0x62eca4] at once; part of the 0x7c28bc..0x7c3ae4 state block 0x40b264 saves) drawn 2 in a third of the picks; words 0x62eb20[4c + s] and 0x62eb78[4c + s] (s = 0 or 2 by the sign of 0x7c2ea9; written by 0x4086bc/0x43ccae) any u16, varied over the whole span the index can form; i16 0x66d7aa[c] (written by the race code) any value. Bytes 0x66d896 and 0x66d87d are car numbers compared with the flagged car byte (je at 0x43cfc9/0x43cfda; flag 0x7aafd4 gates the second): drawn as flagged numbers 0x81..0x83 or 0x96, or unflagged/zero, so both equalities and misses occur. Only table reads at fixed addresses; nothing faults.
